entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-30
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Compound assignments not considered to invoke get accessor (IDE0052) #81821
  • Memory leak in ServiceHub.RoslynCodeAnalysisService.exe #81820
  • [VS2026] Codelens does not appear/work for extension methods with new C#14 keyword #81819
  • Severe SemanticModel performance regression with Roslyn 5.0 vs 4.14 - 4x slower #81815

Closed

  • VisualBasicCompilation.GetTypeInfo returns `null` for `ObjectCreationExpressionSyntax.Type` #75147
    Backlog
  • SemanitModel.GetTypeInfo returns null Type on ObjectCreationExpressionSyntax.Type #78783
  • Errors are not shown in the error list and editor in VS 2026 #81818
  • Decimal literal not recognised as a literal when declaring an attribute. #81817
  • Cannot assign void to an implicitly-typed variable in visual studio 2026 #81803

PullRequests

Created

  • Let Razor fill in project information on diagnostics #81822
    Area-IDE
  • Ensure extension receiver is converted for pattern matching Deconstruct and pattern based `using` scenarios. #81816
    Area-Compilers
  • Move to async/await (Workspaces) layer #81814
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Move to async/await (LanguageServer) layer #81812
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode
  • Move to async/await (Analyzers) layer #81811
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Move to async/await (EditorFeatures) layer #81809
    Area-IDE, VSCode

Merged

  • Move to async/await (Features) layer #81810
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Enable GetTypeInfo for type of object creation syntax #81802
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Improve error recovery around 'scoped' modifier parsing #81636
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Move to async/await (VisualStudio) layer #81813
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Revert "Update methods to be `async`." #81808
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next

Updated

  • Suppress ERR_BadRetType and ERR_MethDelegateMismatch for delegate conversions with omitted type arguments #81278
  • Fix WasPropertyBackingFieldAccessChecked assertion with query continuations #81793
  • Let tuple/anonymous member name inference see through null suppression operator #80908
    Area-Compilers, Community
